intro: Sticks and Bones is a local task offered by Deathguard Bartholomew in Tirisfal Glades. He sends travelers to gather dry branches across the blighted woodland to deliver to Eleanor Shackleton, an experienced survivalist camped in the western hills.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."
If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.
I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
